reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides Superpowers methodology skills and a persistent session bootstrap for agent planning, TDD, debugging, brainstorming, and code review.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供用于头脑风暴、规划、测试驱动开发、调试和代码审查的 Superpowers 方法论技能及会话引导。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with Superpowers methodology skills and session bootstrapping for brainstorming, planning, test-driven development, debugging, and code review.

capabilities: Registers 14 agent skills for brainstorming, planning, test-driven development, debugging, and code review
Adds a persistent bootstrap section to the system prompt
Maps Claude Code-style tool names to DeepSeek Harness equivalents
Optionally loads an upstream-hosted visual logo without sending project or prompt content
